★ Request
Loves puts away book
I take out my smartphone and operate it right in front of her.

Of course, everyone had their own schedules. Even so, we
had all promised to gather together for this very moment.

Allow me to correct myself. There truly are Umamusume who grow stronger for the sake of others.
...And you just proved it with your own running.

I'm ready.
But... what do you mean by "I want you to do a stream"?

Ehehe♡
Though it wasn't just me who proved it—it was *all of us*♪
Haaah!

...Okay.
Well then, let's get started.

And I heard she only just partnered with a Trainer recently, too...!
When I've been dedicating everything solely to training...!

—... I had no idea you were a channel member too.
So... you knew everything that had been happening, and prepared this for me.
Alrighty... that should do it.

...Loves Only You.
You have far more power now than when I first tried to scout you.
Because—

That... of course I remember.
As of today, 9,927 members.
There's no way this many viewers could—

—Let's sign the contract.
Right here, in front of everyone.
I'll turn this love... into major victories, and give it all right back to everyone.

Aww, come on, what's wrong with that?
Besides, don't you feel way more... *love* this way?

How's everyone doing~?
Love Me♡ Love You♡ It's Loves Only You!♡

No. Even if that happens, our starting number will never change.
It'll always be a precious number that I'll cherish for the rest of my life♪
Ngh... What?!

—... I had no idea you were a channel member too.
So... you knew everything that had been happening, and prepared this for me.

If that reaches even further and touches even more people...
That would be the absolute greatest love ever, right?
Phew...!

?
What is it?

But how did you manage to gather everyone together?
We all have completely different schedules and routines.

(Taking a stoic approach makes you stronger... That's probably
the right answer for most people. But it's not right for her.)

The second half...? 
—Ah...

Her streaming interactions with fans are at the very heart of what she does.
This plan will keep that core intact while helping her widen that circle even further.

Because I'm Love Me♡ Love You♡
Loves Only You, after all!♡
—'We hear you!' ...Ahaha, thanks everyone!

(The people who receive my "love" and return their "love" to me...
It's precisely because I feel their presence right beside me—)

To ensure she... never feels alone again. To show her that we are all in this together.
I show her the thick booklet born from those feelings, and speak my piece.
Ehehe. Let's keep making our love grow bigger and bigger together.
What is this...? This can't possibly be the viewer count, right...?

...Whoa, amazing. People are already joining.
Ah, mic check, one two. How is it? Can you hear me?

The love of so many people is pushing me forward.
As long as I'm not alone... there's no limit to how strong I can become♪

I didn't give any notice, so it's a total guerilla stream, but—
...Huh?

...Ehehe.
Thank you... Thank you, everyone.

After confirming everything is ready,
I use my phone to send the "signal" we prepared.

I... I can't...! 
I can't... catch up to her at all—!
—"I'm sure there are even more things you'll want to do"...

A simulation of my aptitudes based on my running, plus... a training plan.
Diet, rest days... Every single detail is covered...
—"Even if I can't lead you by the hand"...
I never even considered it. A path I can't walk together with everyone simply doesn't exist to me.
What do you think, Trainer? ♪
What do you think, Trainer? ♪
—A few days later.

I'm so... so glad I believed in them.
I felt everyone's love loud and clear.
The "9927 Plan"...
